title: Top CO2 emitting countries from 1990 to 2024, annual emissions data
subtitle: 1802 to 2023
hook: Witness how global carbon dioxide emissions shifted dramatically across nations over two centuries.
setup: This animation tracks the historical progression of annual industrial output, highlighting key milestones and surging nations.

sequence.text: The United Kingdom starts as the early leader in carbon dioxide emissions.
The United States surges past other nations to take the top spot in 1888.
Japan makes its first appearance in the ranking in 1897.
India enters the rankings for the first time in 1917.
China enters the global emissions rankings in 1924.
France climbs significantly in the rankings by 1945.
China claims the number one position in 2006.
Indonesia joins the top rankings as a newcomer in 2016.

ending: Industrial growth over the centuries reshaped the global balance of carbon dioxide emissions.
